propositions: File-backed bridge-status implementation and purge-bridge command must remain absent from the codebase following gerrit change 1517.
Hidden bridge-status compatibility alias must route only through canonical durable bridge status parser without resurrecting the removed file-backed module.
Durable bridge_status schema, Python facade, and MCP tool/model registries must remain intact and functional for backward compatibility.
Schema registry exports BRIDGE_STATUS, output-schema entry, and read warnings must be cleaned up to remove references to retired commands.
All occurrences of retired bridge-status and purge-bridge tokens must be absent from active documentation, help output, and top-level command listing.
Gerrit change 1517 removal and final epic durable compatibility alias must be preserved; rollback scenarios must not restore the obsolete file-backed handler.
